title: Tenant-aware shadow validation for pinned models
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: When a tenant or catalog entry pins or upgrades a model version, we should automatically run tenant-scoped shadow validation runs that compare live traffic outputs between the incumbent and candidate versions without affecting customer responses. This ticket implements a tenant-aware shadow validation flow that: (1) subscribes to pin/upgrade events, (2) samples requests per-tenant and mirrors them to a candidate model runner, (3) executes a battery of lightweight eval probes and regression heuristics, and (4) emits a delta report and automated rollback signal if regression thresholds are exceeded. The flow must respect tenant budgets and global cost limits, and integrate with existing eval orchestration and rollback machinery.
design_notes: Core idea: avoid full-fidelity synthetic evals for every pin. Instead, run customer-contextual shadow validation by sampling live requests plus a small suite of synthetic probes (edge cases, safety checks). Use differential metrics (semantic similarity, token-level divergence, response latency, confidence heuristics, safety flags) and a composite regression score. Allow tenants to opt-out or limit budget. Implementation will reuse the eval-fanout bus and the prober infrastructure but add tenant-aware throttling and cost accounting.
implementation_plan: 1) Subscribe to version-pin events from catalog and tenant APIs. 2) Add mirror hook in routing layer to fork sampled requests to candidate model instances with tag 'shadow-tenant-<id>'. 3) Build lightweight probe library for tenant contexts: core prompts, safety probes, and regression anchors. 4) Implement per-tenant sampling policy: configurable rate, priority buckets, and budget constraints. 5) Aggregate results into a delta report: case-level diffs, composite score, and signal generation rules. 6) Wire in automatic rollback actuator that can flip a canary/pinned version when high-confidence regression detected. 7) Add dashboards and per-tenant report storage with retention configurable. 8) E2E tests and staged rollout behind feature flag.
acceptance_criteria: - Shadow validation runs are triggered for both catalog-level and tenant-level pin events in staging. - Per-tenant sampling rate is configurable and enforced (default 0.5% requests). - Delta report includes: semantic similarity metric, latency delta, safety-flag delta, and a composite regression score. - Regression score threshold (configurable) causes an alert and produces a rollback recommendation. - Cost accounting shows additional token/compute spend attributable to shadow runs and respects tenant budget caps. - Integration tests demonstrate that a synthetic regression causes the rollout actuator to recommend rollback and emit the expected alert message.
test_plan: - Unit tests for event subscription, sampling policy, and report assembler. - Integration test: simulate pin event, replay representative tenant traffic, verify mirrored requests reach candidate runner and reports generated. - Fault injection: candidate model returns malformed output or slow responses; validate alarms and non-impact path. - Load test: ensure mirroring at 2x the sampling rate in a high-throughput tenant does not break routing. - Cost test: simulate budget exhaustion and verify mirroring stops and a budget-exhausted event logs.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (behind feature flag, internal tenants): enable for 10 internal tenants, default sample 0.1%. Phase 2 (beta customers): opt-in for selected customers with sample 0.5% and budget guard. Phase 3: global opt-out-by-default for all pins, allow tenant enable and per-tenant budgets. Gradual increase of sample rate with monitoring and kill switch. Provide clear customer communication and settings in Console.
monitoring_and_alerts: - New metric: shadow.validation.runs.count (by tenant, model). - New metric: shadow.validation.regression_score{tenant,model}. - Alert: shadow.validation.regression_score > threshold for 5m -> P0 Pager + rollback recommendation created. - Alert: shadow.validation.cost_exhausted per tenant -> Notify tenant owner, stop mirroring. - Dashboard: per-tenant delta-summary with top failing prompt clusters. - Audit logs: record pin events, reports, and any automated rollback actions.
outstanding_risks: - Cost blowup for very high throughput tenants if sampling not strictly enforced. Mitigation: hard global budget and per-tenant caps. - Privacy/regulatory concerns about mirroring production requests to candidate models in private deployments. Mitigation: honor tenant opt-out and allow only synthetic and anonymized probes in private/on-prem. - False positives in regression heuristics could cause unnecessary rollbacks. Mitigation: conservative thresholds and require human confirmation for tenant-critical catalog pins by default.
